question:
Select the triad which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

DL – IQ – NV

FN – KS – PX
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93f14776146e1792dfc1ef41b7f1a7fc38de939a9182bf5bb356265bbd9f853d.png] Logic followed here is: Each letter in the triad is obtained by adding 5 to the positional value of the corresponding letter in the previous pair. **For DL – IQ – NV →**
